title: Mini-app one-shot answers that land while the account is in the background are drained as news when it comes back
trigger: send web app data (or toggle a bot in the attachment menu) from account A, switch to B before the answer, switch back to A
effect: Session::forget_screen_outcomes (state/session_outcomes.rs) clears earn, payments and message outcomes but not web_apps.data_sent, attachment_menu_toggled, attachment_menu_bot, found, write_access, emoji_access, phone_share or custom_replies; poll_mini_app_session (ui/web_app_ui/spawn_mini_app_window.rs:221-345) then shows 'Sent to the bot' / 'added to menu' notes with no action behind them, and custom_replies (keyed by the app's req_id, not the window) are emitted into whatever mini app window is open
fix: clear the one-shot slots in forget_screen_outcomes (or move them into OnScreen); key custom_replies by the window/launch that sent them

title: ReviewStage::Reviewing counts answers with `waiting: usize` and matches them by session id, not by the RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Press 'No, it's not me' with several unconfirmed sessions and lose one continuation (request dropped, account generation changes) without an error answer
effect: waiting never reaches 0: the alert stays busy and its buttons stay disabled until restart
fix: Reviewing { requests: Vec<(RequestId, UnconfirmedEntry)> } where each answer or error removes its own request and a lost request is an error

title: AccountNotices::unconfirmed, unconfirmed_count and unconfirmed_entries are three fields that must change together
trigger: updateUnconfirmedSession with count 0, a review that finishes, a getActiveSessions answer
effect: None today; each writer (apply_unconfirmed_session, resolve_unconfirmed_entries, finish_login_review) clears or fills them by hand, so a new writer can leave a count with no entries (alert with no buttons)
fix: one `Unconfirmed { first, count, entries: Fetch<Vec<UnconfirmedEntry>> }` value replaced whole

title: TwofaFlow keeps code_wait, notice and refetch as separate one-shot slots cleared by hand from the UI
trigger: A reset result lands while the two-step dialog is closed, or the dialog moves view without going through goto_twofa_view
effect: A stale notice line ('Two-step verification was disabled') shows on the next open; clear_twofa_flow and goto_twofa_view are the only clearers (ui/security/mod.rs:616-620)
fix: one TwofaFlow stage enum owned by the dialog (CodeWait/Notice as variants) cleared when the dialog closes

title: Login-URL answers are matched by purpose only: last_login_url_info and login_url_request are two Options not tied to a request
trigger: Press a login-URL button, press another one (or press twice) before the first getLoginUrlInfo answers
effect: The first answer lands as the answer of the second press; an error of either takes the other's login_url_request (error.rs:208) and degrades the wrong button to its fallback URL
fix: one LoginUrlStage { Idle, Asking { request: RequestId, ctx }, Answered(info) } and match answers by RequestId

title: LiveBursts::Requested holds no RequestId; the stickers answer is matched by purpose only
trigger: set_live_bursts(stickers) runs for any GetBursts answer; a second GetBursts (after the error reset to Unasked) can be answered out of order
effect: An older answer lands on a newer request or after a reset
fix: Requested(RequestId) matched in set_live_bursts / apply_live_story_error, or Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>>

title: `inactive_session_ttl_days: Option` is the loading flag; a refused save with previous None restores None = loading forever
trigger: Open privacy while the first getActiveSessions is unanswered, set the timeout, the save is refused
effect: The timeout row reads as still loading and nothing refetches it (the code comment says so)
fix: Fetch<i32> for the timeout so loading, ready and failed are variants and a failed save restores Ready(previous) or leaves Failed with a retry

title: check_password_suggested mirrors the 'suggestedActionCheckPassword' entry of chat_list.suggestions
trigger: The server removes the suggested action while a hideSuggestedAction fails
effect: Two copies of one fact updated in apply_privacy_data_payload and apply_privacy_data_ok; HideSuggestedAction's error re-adds only the list copy
fix: Derive the bool from suggestions (has_action(CHECK)) and delete the field

title: begin_thread replaces the ThreadView whole, so stale_pages of the old view is lost and in-flight pages of the old opening land in the new view of the same origin
trigger: Open comments of post P, close, reopen P before the first page answered
effect: The old opening's page (different window/anchor) is applied to the new view whose thread_id/root_ids are not resolved yet; rows or completion flags from the wrong window
fix: Give each ThreadView an opening token carried by its requests (like WindowViews::openings), match answers to it

title: needs_translation treats Failed as 'no translation needed', so an automatic pump never retries a failed message
trigger: Translate a chat automatically, one translateMessageText fails (error, 'lost', 'send')
effect: The row shows 'translation error' for good; only an edit of the message (forget_message_translations) or a manual send clears it
fix: Failed with a retry mark/backoff, or a retry action on the failed row

title: TranslateState::messages is never pruned with chat history or the chat leaving the kept set
trigger: Read many translated chats in one session
effect: Done translations (text and entities) of every message in every language stay for the life of the session, beyond the history they belong to
fix: Drop a chat's entries in history_prune / release_chat_history

title: MessageStatsFetch and StoryStatsFetch default to Loading with no RequestId
trigger: The page state is created in Loading before the request exists; the answer and the error are matched by (chat id, message id) or (chat id, story id), not by the request the stage waits for
effect: A second request for the same post (a Retry that races an older answer) can fill or fail the page from the wrong request
fix: Loading{request: RequestId} (or Fetch<T>) matched with waits_for

title: Stories page answers carry no stamp and are matched by chat only
trigger: Open the gallery, let a Stories page start, close and reopen the same chat: a late page with generation None is accepted by accepts_profile for the new open; a late failure can mark the new Loading tab Failed
effect: The tab shows the old page or a failure until the new request answers
fix: Send the stamp with getChatPostedToChatPageStories as Gifts does

title: WebApps::pending is a Vec that never holds more than one launch
trigger: Any open call: mark_web_app_pending clears the Vec before pushing
effect: The doc says 'a second launch keeps its own context' but the only writer clears first, so the collection hides a one-slot stage; readers loop over a list that cannot have two
fix: Option<WebAppPending> (or a keyed map if concurrent launches are meant)

title: Custom-method replies carry only the app's req_id and go to whichever mini app window is current
trigger: A mini app sends web_app_invoke_custom_method, is closed (or the window is replaced by another app) before TDLib answers
effect: poll_mini_app_session emits the reply into self.mini_apps.window with the old req_id; a different app that uses the same req_id gets another app's result; custom_requests entries whose answer never comes are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight entry by RequestId with the launch/window it was sent for, and drop the answer (and the entry) when that launch is gone

title: data_sent is an unkeyed one-shot slot taken by whichever poll runs next
trigger: Two keyboard-button mini apps send data close together, or the account is switched away before the answer and back later
effect: The second answer overwrites the first (one 'Sent to the bot' note for two sends, or a failure lost), and an answer that lands while another account is on screen shows its note when this account returns
fix: A per-request outcome keyed by RequestId, taken by the flow that sent it, and cleared in the account's Farewell
